svg.title: Жим на грудь в тренажёре одной рукой — положение 2
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. Two phases of seated single-arm machine chest press. Upright back against backrest and feet planted. One hand on right independent lever handle, other hand on thigh. Start right elbow bent and handle next to chest, finish press horizontally forward to extended right arm. Side three-quarter view, show whole machine and pivot. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
